statement: The `## Context` heading consulted when claiming a legacy record MUST be matched by the same rules as every other section heading: case-insensitively, and at any heading level. A legacy record written by a conformant emitter that chose `### Context` or `## context` still records the same question and MUST still be claimed.
engine_divergence: The reference implementation at v0.8.3 matches this heading with a case-sensitive, level-2-only pattern, so it does NOT claim the legacy file and mints `2026-07-25-how-do-we-parse-dates.md` instead (verified by execution for both `## context` and `### Context`). The direction is safe -- it forks rather than overwrites -- but idempotency silently breaks for any record whose heading a case-insensitive parser accepted on the read path.
note: Divergence, flagged. The conformance target is the reuse shown above.
